_about: Independent check of states/elected_2026.json, 2026-11-14. Each figure checked against pages opened (robots.txt checked first). 'confirmed' = an opened page states the file's figure (or it follows by arithmetic from stated figures); 'corrected' = an opened page gives a different figure; 'unconfirmed' = no opened page states it. Unofficial results; many counts were taken in the days after November 3 and may have moved.
